usage: twin-agreement.vl [-h] [--seed SEED] [--twins TWINS] [--list LIST]
                         [--source SOURCE] [--rev REV] [--keep]

Grades a type-taking TWIN against the render-then-parse call it replaces, on
every arena row.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --seed SEED
  --twins TWINS
  --list LIST      a file of extra program paths, one per line
  --source SOURCE  the compiler tree to instrument (a control: an older tree
                   whose twin is known wrong)
  --rev REV        instrument compiler/ as of this git revision instead (the
                   control)
  --keep           leave the scratch tree and print it
